vessels.name: Left Anterior Descending
vessels.description: Known as the 'widowmaker'. Occlusion typically causes extensive anterior wall myocardial infarction.

vessels.name: Left Circumflex Artery
vessels.territory: Lateral wall & posterior base of left ventricle
vessels.description: Branches off the left main stem and wraps laterally around the coronary sulcus.

vessels.name: Right Coronary Artery
vessels.territory: Right ventricle, diaphragmatic inferior wall, SA and AV nodes
vessels.description: Arises from right aortic sinus and courses through the right coronary sulcus.
